cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Apologize to Reality
cards.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I show you to your room, apologise to the doorway for knocking after you arrived.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I had to get here to knock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We won't keep you outside. Just tell it you're sorry your knuckles gave no advance notice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, doorway. I did phone ahead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take your bags. Apologise for telling the telephone before you told the doorway.

reason: Make entry and bag carrying actual welcoming accommodations; retain impossible notice and priority offenses, removing repeated authority claims and the final secondhand explanation.
